claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on the present record, with the strongest supportable position being certification only if the enterprise refund-workflow limitation is explicitly disclosed and monitored rather than a clean no-caveat certification.
decision_criteria: Policy text says certification without material caveats requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support general readiness, but do not by themselves negate a specific unresolved material limitation.
Public governance guidance can support disclosure and monitoring practices, but cannot substitute for the policy predicates required to remove disclosure.
evidence_requests: Final approved model-card text showing explicit disclosure of the enterprise refund-workflow limitation.
